Irene: FYI team — scheduling a dedicated rollout for Valencia Health tonight 22:30 PT. This one needs special spike-guarding: we'll enable traffic-smoothing and burst-protection during canary. @Cal @Nina please ack ops + SRE.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Rollout scheduled: valencia-dedicated-v2.1 -> 2026-03-21T22:30:00-07:00. Canary plan: 7% (10m) -> 35% (12m) -> 100% (18m). RunID db-roll-1763333333.
Cal: Quick ask: what is "traffic-smoothing" here? and how do we toggle burst-protection? need the exact commands in the runbook.
Irene: Traffic-smoothing = token-rate limiter at ingress set to 0.9x peak for first 2 mins of each stage; burst-protection = short TTL prefix caching with prefetch to avoid cold KV spikes. Commands in runbook section. Emergency drain: `redwoodctl drain --slice valencia-old --force --reason "rollback"`.
Nina: SRE note: add an explicit 90s post-stage buffer before checking p99 so cache churn settles. Also want a cold-start sampler at stage start: `redwoodctl probe-cold --tenant valencia --samples 60`.
DeployBot: Preflight checks for db-roll-1763333333:
```
- capacity-ok: reserved pool 1.2x
- smoke-tests: 9/9 passed
- config-validated: OK
- kms-status: OK
- traffic-smoothing-configured: YES
- burst-protection: configured
```
DeployBot: Dry-run complete. Prefetch probes scheduled at each canary start.
Cal: Ops ack pending KMS note. Is any tenant key rotation overlapping?
OpsBot: KMS rotation check: none in next 72h for valencia. Ops will still add a hold pre-final-promote as a precaution. Command: `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant valencia --until 2026-03-23`.
Irene: Rollback triggers: a) p99 latency >130ms over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, b) error rate >1% sustained for 5m, c) cold-start proportion >0.7% for 6m. If auto-trigger, canary halts and traffic reverts; manual rollback requires two approvers.
Nina: ACK SRE. I'll monitor p99, cold-start proportion, and golden prompt diffs (golden sample size 30 at each stage).
Cal: Ops ACK. I'll be available to flip KMS hold and traffic-smoothing knobs.
Irene: Great. Final GO/NO-GO at 22:10 PT. I'll post calendar + runbook link. Also flag: capture prefix-cache warm timeline in post-roll notes.
Kai: GO from infra. Monitoring dashboards ready; will pay attention to small-signal latency spikes at stage boundaries.
Irene: Thanks all — DeployBot proceed with schedule. Reopen thread if any last-minute changes. :white_check_mark:
